analysis_expected_outcome: Both conditional templates entailed; failure counts evaluated as observations and duplicate groups, not proven real-world attempts.
cache_condition: Fresh temporary case; operating-system caches were not evicted. Reads follow import and verification.

clock_assumption.scope: The generated benchmark artifact only; no real host calibration is asserted.

environment_limitations: Linux host measurement; not a macOS reference measurement.
CPU affinity limits eligible CPUs, not exclusive CPU availability.
Other host workloads were not stopped; this is not an isolated performance laboratory.

measurement_scope.clock_setup: Production save_clock validation and immutable write for an explicitly synthetic clock assumption.
measurement_scope.full_verify: Production CaseStore.verify including full source hashing and stored integrity checks.
measurement_scope.import: Production CaseStore.ingest including parser worker and checkpoints; source generation excluded.
measurement_scope.load_data: Production load_data, including its own mandatory verification, pagination and analytic projection.
measurement_scope.rss: Process lifetime peak including generation, import, verification, setup and analysis. Child value is RUSAGE_CHILDREN maximum, not a sum of simultaneous workers.
measurement_scope.two_templates: One correlate_many_data call over loaded data; includes validation, semantic digests and both templates. No source-file I/O.

memory_profile: Host allocation; no 16 GiB reference-machine memory cap was applied.

observer_notes.basis: Coordinated task confirmation and local process-list observation; added after the timed run.
known_workload_overlap: A separate application unit-test suite overlapped part of clock_setup and load_data.
observer_notes.limitation: This does not establish an isolated host or quantify the influence of the earlier overlapping workload.
observer_notes.two_templates: The unit-test suite had finished before this measured batch; no test or build workload was running during the batch.

page_sampling.condition: Post-verification reads; the first sample is not a cold-cache measurement.

threshold_interpretation: These flags compare this single observed Linux run with numeric targets; they do not establish equivalent reference hardware, cold-cache performance or other-platform support.
